label: Starting before you feel ready (creator paralysis)
summary: A face-free topic pack about the gap between wanting to start a YouTube channel and actually pressing record. Everything lives in the ordinary evidence of stalled momentum and quiet progress: the phone, the notes app, the unopened gear, the blinking cursor, the messy desk at 2am. No cast, no drama — just the objects that carry the feeling.
topicDirection: Use phones, laptops, notebooks, desks, unopened gear boxes, cameras, and bedroom-studio setups to carry the feeling of wanting to start versus actually starting. No people, faces, hands, or bodies; keep every surface unoccupied so the object itself does the emotional work.

storyBeats.single: one moment of stalled or resumed momentum
storyBeats.opening: the spark and the pull toward starting
storyBeats.early: the stall dressed up as preparation
storyBeats.middle: the fear underneath the stall, named plainly
storyBeats.late: the small real action that breaks the freeze
storyBeats.final: the plain, unglamorous first step, taken anyway

sentimentRules.phrase: restless, hopeful pull toward something not yet started
busy stillness, motion that never leaves the couch
a reasonable-sounding excuse standing in for the real one
quiet, specific fear of being seen before you're good
private, repetitive self-editing nobody else will ever see
an impossible bar that only exists in your own head
small, plain, unglamorous action taken anyway
an honest, unfinished-feeling beginning, kept rather than hidden

subjectTypePerson: an unoccupied object or space that stands in for the person without depicting them

continuityTemplate: Scene {{sceneNumber}} of {{total}}. Keep the same lived-in, ordinary world while changing the dominant object, room, camera distance, and light from neighboring scenes.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A phone rests screen-up on a rumpled bed at night, a blank new-video-idea note glowing faintly on the lock screen.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close overhead 50mm view, shallow focus on the screen, dark room falling away around it.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A laptop sits open on a desk with an empty, cursor-blinking document behind a browser tab bar full of open research pages.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Medium desk-level view, screen glow as the only light source, keyboard and desk objects soft in the foreground.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A phone propped shakily against a stack of books faces an empty chair, the camera app open but not recording.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Low tripod-height angle looking past the phone toward the empty seat, room dim and still.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A closed laptop sits at the far edge of a desk, everything else pushed away from it, one small lamp casting a narrow pool of light.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Wide, mostly empty desk composition with heavy negative space around the one lit object.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A phone screen shows a long list of saved how-to videos, thumbnails stacked far past the visible screen edge.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close handheld-style phone-screen framing, warm lamp light spilling in from one side.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A notebook lies open to a page of crossed-out video title ideas, pen resting diagonally across the page.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Overhead flat-lay at desk height, soft window light, notebook centered with room to breathe around it.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: An unopened ring-light box and a boxed microphone sit stacked in a corner, shrink wrap still sealed.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Medium corner-of-room view, boxes slightly dusty, rest of the room softly out of focus.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A basic laptop webcam sits above a screen in an ordinary bedroom, the room around it plain and lived-in.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close three-quarter view of the laptop lid and camera, bedroom detail soft behind it.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A phone's camera-roll grid shows the same short clip thumbnail repeated many times over.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close top-down phone-screen shot, grid filling most of the frame, thumb hovering near the edge.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A single desk chair faces an empty wall where a backdrop has been half clipped up and left unfinished.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Wide static room view, chair and half-hung backdrop as the only subjects, evening light through a window.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A bedroom mirror reflects an empty room and an unmade tripod leaning unused against the wall beside it.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Medium mirror-reflection composition, soft available light, no figure present in the reflection.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: An old, slightly worn phone plays a grainy home-video clip on its cracked screen, propped against a stack of paperbacks.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close object-level view, screen glow lighting the surrounding desk clutter.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A cheap ring light glows unevenly in a cluttered bedroom corner, cables tangled across the floor beneath it.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Medium-wide corner view, uneven light spill, ordinary mess kept fully in frame.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A stack of old notebooks and a worn external hard drive sit beside a laptop, corners curled from use.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close 50mm still life, desk-level, warm practical light from one side.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A phone screen shows a video with a single view count, sitting quietly among a longer list of titles.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close phone-screen framing, screen the only bright element in a dim room.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A blank sheet of paper sits center-desk under a single lamp, nothing written on it yet.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Tight overhead flat-lay, one lamp, generous dark negative space surrounding the paper.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A clock reads past 2am on a nightstand beside a phone lit up with an unfinished notes app draft.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close nightstand-level still life, warm low light, rest of the bedroom dark around it.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A row of ten identical blank index cards lies fanned across a desk, only the first one slightly worn at the corner.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Overhead flat-lay, even light, cards arranged left to right in a clean line.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: An editing timeline glows on a laptop screen in a dark room, a single rough clip already dropped into place.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Medium desk-level view, screen light dominant, keyboard and mouse soft in the foreground.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A single blank sticky note is pressed onto an otherwise empty wall above a desk.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close wall-level shot, soft daylight, wide empty wall space surrounding the one note.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A phone's notes app shows a single unfinished draft, cursor blinking at the end of an incomplete line.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close phone-screen framing, shallow depth of field, warm indoor light.

sceneDirectionRules.match: \b(?:open your camera|right now|true thing|press the button)\b
sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A phone camera app sits open with the shutter button glowing, aimed at a plain, ordinary room.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Medium point-of-view framing over the top of the phone, room softly lit, nothing staged.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: A single video file icon sits alone in an otherwise empty folder window on a laptop screen.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Close screen-level shot, folder mostly empty, one file catching the light.

sceneDirectionRules.visualAction: Early morning light breaks through a bedroom window onto a small desk setup, camera finally powered on and steady.
sceneDirectionRules.shotPlan: Wide window-lit room view, warm sunrise tone, desk setup calm and resolved in the frame.

fallbackVisualAction: Show one ordinary object from an aspiring creator's world — a phone, laptop, notebook, unopened gear box, or plain bedroom desk — as the literal subject of the line, without inventing drama beyond what the line states.
fallbackShots: Close desk-level or nightstand-level still life with one object dominant and soft ambient light.
Medium bedroom or desk view with one supporting object and a calm, uncluttered background.
Close phone-screen or laptop-screen framing with the screen as the only bright element.
Wide, mostly empty room view using window light or lamp light to isolate the one subject.
negatives: person, people, human, face, facial features, skin, body, hands, fingers, arms, legs, silhouette, reflection of a person, visible occupant, crowd, portrait, readable text, readable screen content, logos
